subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Partitioning Non-Numeric Inputs
description: A micro-lesson that makes Partitioning Non-Numeric Inputs usable.

hook.text: A dropdown has three options: Small, Medium, Large. How do you partition inputs that aren't numbers?

buildup.text: Equivalence partitioning works on any input type—strings, dropdowns, file types, boolean flags, and dates.

discovery.text: For a file upload: valid partitions include JPG, PNG; invalid partitions include EXE, empty file, and oversized file.

twist.text: Non-numeric partitions are easy to forget. Teams test number fields carefully but skip dropdown and string validations.

climax.text: Thinking in partitions—not just values—works for every input type and makes test design systematic.

punchline.text: Partitions aren't just for numbers. Apply them everywhere.

quiz.question: Can equivalence partitioning be applied to non-numeric inputs?
options: Yes, it works on any input type
